definition.def: You use overseas to describe things that involve or are in foreign countries, usually across a sea or an ocean.
examples: He has returned to South Africa from his long overseas trip.

definition.def: An overseas student or visitor comes from a foreign country, usually across a sea or an ocean.
examples: Every year millions of overseas visitors come to London.
